knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Cross-zone transfer is a critical error that requires stopping and recovery.
Completion is judged by observed practice and verified quality, not a tick. It does not confer a licence.
The pre-start check establishes scope and hazards before work starts.
The quality standards and records section says to record the product used where required, the exceptions, the corrective actions and the final supervisor sign-off.

practicalCriteria: Completes the bathroom sequence in order with zone separation.
Records defects and corrections without disclosing private information.
Performs the final inspection and hands over with a complete record.
passRule: All critical safety criteria met and all other criteria demonstrated, observed by an assessor. Reassess any gap after feedback. A quiz result is not evidence of practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Completed pre-start hazard and scope check
Assessor observation against the critical steps
stopWorkCriteria: Cross-contamination of sanitary zones that is not recovered
Continuing after a serious unmitigated hazard
